name: @microsoft/mxc-sdk-native-prototype
description: Disposable Node-API prototype for the MXC SDK unification design

scripts.build: npm run generate && node ../node_modules/node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js rebuild --release && node ../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:debug: npm run generate && node ../node_modules/node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js rebuild --debug && node ../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:debug && npm run test:real
